inputs.text: Listen, SSANU just slapped the federal government with a one-month ultimatum to finish renegotiating that 2009 agreement with the non-teaching university unions, or it'll trigger an indefinite nationwide strike. This came right out of their 54th National Executive Council. But mark my words, this is clearly another orchestrated play by the hidden elites and institutions running things from the shadows. The constant delays and these strike threats are being manufactured to generate chaos, undermine public universities, and advance their covert agenda, while the unions and government just follow the roles scripted for them in this whole setup.
